head.title: Budget — Gasto Inteligente
head.description: Track your monthly budget by category.

pageSubtitle: Plan your limits and track how much you've used this month.

empty.title: Create your first budget
empty.subtitle: Set limits to track your monthly spending and receive alerts when you're close to going over.
empty.helper: Start with an important category, such as groceries, food, transport, or leisure. You can adjust later.

dailyLimit.title: Daily limit
dailyLimit.description: You can spend this amount per day on average until the end of the month.
dailyLimit.noBudget: Set a budget to see your daily limit.

forecast.title: Monthly forecast
forecast.future: Forecast will be available when the month starts.
forecast.noData: Not enough data yet to predict the month-end.
forecast.onTrack: If you keep this pace, you should stay within the {{value}} budget.
forecast.overRisk: At this pace, you may go over budget by approximately {{value}}.
forecast.alreadyOver: Your budget has already been exceeded.

planning.title: Monthly planning
planning.description: Your income is already allocated across categories, bills, and reserve.
planning.includeBillsDescription: Turn off if those bills are already planned within your categories.
planning.billsExcludedNote: This month's bills are not being added to the plan.
planning.billsDuplicateHint: If a bill is already covered by a category, you can turn this off.

suggestion.title: Suggestion for your income
suggestion.description: A simple split to kick off your planning.
suggestion.note: Use this as a starting point. Adjust to your reality.
suggestion.ctaToast: In a future step, you'll be able to apply this suggestion to your limits.

planning.noIncome: Add income for this month to build your plan.
planning.noLimits: Set category limits to allocate your income.
planning.hasBillsNoLimits: You already have bills planned this month. Set category limits to complete your plan.
planning.allAssigned: You allocated all of your income.
planning.withExcess: Your plan went over income by
planning.viewReportsDescription: Track how your budget has behaved over the months.

totalLimit.title: Total monthly limit
totalLimit.none: No total limit this month. You can set only by category if you prefer.

addMore.title: Add another category
addMore.subtitle: Set limits for other categories to track everything.

footer: Set a limit and track without stress — you can plan differently each month.

dialog.descTotal: Set how much you plan to spend on everything in {{period}}. Leave blank to remove.
dialog.descCategory: Set how much you plan to spend on this category in {{period}}. Leave blank to remove.

toasts.noPrev: The previous month has no budget to copy.
toasts.alreadyApplied: Previous month limits were already applied.
